item.title: Transmission issue causes Mercer County power outage Monday night
item.description: A power outage Monday night disrupted electrical service for customers served by Grundy Electric Cooperative, affecting large portions of Mercer County. According to an online outage report, 1,095 homes and businesses were without electricity.
